title: CONOR SHANAHAN WINS D1GP TOKYO DRIFT

headline: CONOR SHANAHAN
WINS D1GP
IN ODAIBA
data.body: The Formula DRIFT champion only just made it through solo in 16th, then beat Kojiro Meguwa in the semi-final and Naoki Nakamura in the final. Guest entry in the Red Bull CUSCO Racing GR Corolla. Brother Jack missed tsuiso both days.

headline: CONOR SHANAHAN
WINS D1GP
IN ODAIBA
text_version.body: The Formula DRIFT champion only just made it through solo in 16th, then beat Kojiro Meguwa in the semi-final and Naoki Nakamura in the final. Guest entry in the Red Bull CUSCO Racing GR Corolla. Brother Jack missed tsuiso both days.

caption:
A guest win in Japan. @conorshanahan79 scraped through solo in 16th, then beat Naoki Nakamura in the final of D1GP Round 10 at TOKYO DRIFT in the wet. His explanation: it always rains in Ireland. 🇮🇪

@conorshanahan79
